title: Local Media Center
noPick: This browser doesn't support the native directory picker (Chrome / Edge do); use the path field below
phPath: Enter an absolute directory path (subfolders included; view documents / run Python), e.g. /Users/you/Movies/Clip
tipPicker: Picker mode supports video playback only (the browser can't expose absolute paths, so it can't read documents / run Python); use the path field above for those two.
hint1: Pick a folder first; the page splits it into sections automatically based on its contents: video carousel / images / documents / Python effects.
hint2: It never reads any fixed path — whatever you pick is what it shows; new files appear automatically afterwards.
pickerEmpty1: No videos in this directory yet, or reading failed.
pickerEmpty2: Need documents / Python effects? Use "Enter Path" above — in picker mode the browser can't obtain absolute paths, and only it can play videos.
serverEmpty: There is no media / document / script to display in this directory.
errOldMiddleware: The backend is still the old middleware (no subfolder listing, can't run Python as a module). Please restart the dev server: Ctrl+C to stop, then npm run dev again
errEmptyPath: Please enter the absolute directory path
docPickHint: Select a document on the left to view it
cannotPreview: The browser can't preview {name} directly (binary Word / Excel / PPT format)
downloadOpen: Download / open with a local app
imgMore: {n} more images; scroll down to keep loading
phArgs: e.g. --frames 30 (try fewer frames first); leave empty to use the script default
noNumpy: None of these interpreters has numpy / Pillow installed, so projects like these won't run. Please run pip install -r requirements.txt first (or create a .venv inside the project folder and retry)
nonDefaultPy: The current interpreter isn't the recommended default ({py}); if it reports missing modules, switch back to the recommended one.
